messages.subject: Executive Profile | GCC Energy Transition, ESG & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Andrew,

I am reaching out directly after an earlier message to Daniel Brook was blocked at delivery. Your role across commercial, strategy, portfolio, business development and executive search at WeConnect Energy aligns closely with the senior mandates I am pursuing across the GCC.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My leadership remit spans ESG and sustainability, government and regulatory relations, external and corporate affairs, strategic partnerships, executive advisory and country-facing coordination in a complex, regulated mining environment.

My work sits at the intersection of major investment, government, regulators, communities and operating teams. I also support governance and external positioning around AGM's approximately 46-50 MWp solar platform and more than 80 MWh of battery storage, alongside carbon-accounting and broader sustainability work.

I am interested in senior mandates across Saudi Arabia, the UAE and the wider GCC, including Country Director or Representative, Executive Director, Director or Head of Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, ESG and Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, External Affairs, Stakeholder Engagement and Country Operations. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

I have attached my current GCC executive CV for your review. I would value consideration for current or upcoming mandates where senior stakeholder leadership, energy-transition exposure, government interface and country execution are central to the role.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director | ESG | Corporate Affairs | Government Relations
